title: fal Launches FLUX 3 Max Tied for No. 1 Image to Video Quality
summary:
The new AI video generator by fal Research and Black Forest Labs produces a 10 second clip in roughly 12 seconds at 720p or 768p resolution. Named FLUX 3 Max, the model is tied for No. 1 in image to video quality based on independent third party benchmarks. It debuted at No. 6 on Design Arena leaderboards for both video and image to video categories, the highest ranking for any fal model to date.

The tool is currently available for text to video, image to video, and keyframe generation on the fal platform. To mark the launch, the company is offering a 75% discount for three weeks to target the most affordable pricing for a frontier video model of this quality. The release places the firm alongside other industry leaders including Google DeepMind and Alibaba Wan.

Introducing FLUX 3 Max, the latest post-trained video model from fal Research in partnership with @bfl_ai.

FLUX 3 Max is tied for #1 in image-to-video quality on independent third-party benchmarks, generating a 10-second, 720/768p video in ~12 seconds.

For the next three weeks, FLUX 3 Max is 75% off, making it the most affordable frontier video model at its quality level.
